reason: Native Windows with CPU-only PyTorch and no CUDA device; minicheck and vllm are absent. The authors document the exact 7B MiniCheck/vLLM interface as Linux-only. Available RAM is insufficient even for an unquantized 7B two-byte-per-parameter weights estimate (14 GB), before runtime overhead. The frozen protocol prohibits quantization, substitution or OOM redesign.
memory_estimate_note: 14 GB is a conservative weights-only estimate, not a vendor minimum; the published 48 GB benchmark is not a minimum requirement.
